name: PayrollRTI 0.1.0
body:
## What's changed

- Restore HMRC's list of affected macOS versions (4d632d2)
- Scope the BPT launch problem to macOS 27 Golden Gate (954985f)
- Remove placeholder update-banner screenshot (d606490)
- Name not-installed marketing shots bpt-not-installed-* (8b503d7)
- Add marketing screenshots (159c16f)
- Add scripted marketing screenshots (c3afec1)
- Document BPT start-up steps, backups and the fresh-install error (45980a1)
- Shut down cleanly on SIGTERM, SIGHUP and SIGINT (e872655)
- Run BPT's database setup and exit backup around the server (433edef)
- Read Basic PAYE Tools' full version from CFBundleVersion (45a6b79)
- Describe signing account as seatofthepants.net Ltd (f4d747d)
- Update GitHub Actions to Node 24 versions (ac2adce)
- Add README with install, troubleshooting and release setup (9b722a7)
- Add CI workflow and format script (c395d2f)
- Add release pipeline (505c92f)
- Add app icon and DMG background (4d4ee5d)
- Apply swift-format and SwiftLint fixes (1ed00bc)
- Add stub BPT and debug snapshots for smoke testing (286a898)
- Add main window, menu-bar status item and settings (2918a7f)
- Embed BPT in a WKWebView with browser behaviours it relies on (e882676)
- Check GOV.UK for newer Basic PAYE Tools releases (3ef779f)
- Spawn and supervise the rti server (db6aa2a)
- Locate Basic PAYE Tools and read its version (4afbb7a)
- Scaffold SwiftUI macOS app project (df06886)

Requires HMRC's free [Basic PAYE Tools](https://www.gov.uk/basic-paye-tools) installed in /Applications.
